title: Dharwad Peda
description: Caramelized deep-brown milk sweet with a subtly grainy texture and fine sugar coating, holding over 175 years of culinary continuity in Dharwad.
altText: Caramelized brown Dharwad Peda confections dusted with fine sugar on a hammered brass plate.
historicalBackground: Introduced by the Thakur family in Line Bazar, Dharwad over 175 years ago; registered under Geographical Indication Application No. 80 on September 9, 2008.
